title: Measuring Global Cellular Matrix Metalloproteinase and Metabolic Activity in 3D Hydrogels
protocol: Synthesize fluorescent protease-degradable peptides utilizing fluorescein and dabcyl.
Dissolve the peptide in DMSO to a concentration of 10 mM.
Store peptide solution in -80°C freezer in small (~30 µL) aliquots.
Prepare 8 arm 40 kDa poly(ethylene glycol) amine (PEG)-norbornene (NB).
Verify end group functionalization using 1H NMR for greater than 90%.
Dissolve PEG-NB in sterile phosphate buffer saline (PBS) at 25% w/v.
Store PEG-NB solution in -80°C freezer in (~300 µL) aliquots.
Synthesize the photo-initiator lithium phenyl 2,4,6 trimethylbenzoylphosphinate (LAP).
Dissolve LAP in sterile water to a concentration of 68 mM.
Store LAP solution in -80°C freezer in (~300 µL) aliquots.
Dissolve the MMP-degradable peptide crosslinker in sterile water to a concentration of 200 mM.
Store MMP-degradable peptide crosslinker aliquots at -80°C.
Dissolve the cell adhesion peptide CRGDS in sterile water to a concentration of 100 mM.
Store cell adhesion peptide aliquots at -80°C.
Heat-inactivate 100 mL of FBS for 30 min at 55 °C.
Add 0.25% w/v activated charcoal and 0.025% w/v dextran to approximately 5 mL of heated FBS.
Stir the mixture until a slurry is formed, then add the rest of the FBS.
Stir the mixture for 30 min at 55 °C.
Centrifuge the mixture at 1,962 x g for 20 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the supernatant to another vessel.
Repeat heat-inactivation and charcoal stripping steps at 37 °C.
Centrifuge the mixture again at 1,962 x g for 20 min at 4 °C.
Sterilize the supernatant using a 0.45 µm filter followed by a 0.2 µm filter.
Prepare assay media with media supplemented with 1% charcoal stripped FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, 10 U/mL penicillin, and 10 µg/mL streptomycin.
Prepare the hydrogel precursor solution in a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 20 mM 8 arm 40 kDa PEG-NB to the tube.
Vortex after addition of each component.
Add 12.75 mM crosslinker MMP-degradable peptide and vortex.
Add 17.8 mM NaOH and vortex.
Add 1 mM CRGDS and vortex.
Add 2 mM LAP and vortex.
Add 0.25 mM fluorogenic MMP-degradable peptide and vortex.
Divide the hydrogel precursor solution into multiple 1.5 mL tubes, one tube per condition being tested.
Wash a 10 cm dish of A375 melanoma cells with 10 mL of PBS.
Trypsinize cells using 0.05% trypsin and incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 3 min.
Count cells with a hemocytometer to determine total cell number.
Centrifuge the cell solution at 314 x g for 3 min, aspirate culture media, then re-suspend cells in PBS at approximately three times the highest required seeding density for the experiment.
Count the cells again to ensure an accurate cell concentration.
Add suspended cells and PBS to each tube of hydrogel precursor solution according to the required seeding density.
Do not vortex tubes with cells; pipette up and down vigorously without creating bubbles to mix the precursor solution.
Dispense 10 μL of the hydrogel precursor solution into a sterile black round bottom 96-well plate, ensuring the tip is centered in the middle of each well while dispensing.
Expose the plate to ultra violet (UV) light at 4 mW/cm2 for 3 min for polymerization.
Add 150 μL of assay media to all wells except for the positive control conditions without encapsulated cells.
To the positive controls, add 150 μL of collagenase enzyme solution.
Add 150 μL of PBS to the outer wells of the plate to reduce evaporation during incubation.
Measure fluorescence immediately post-encapsulation at 494 nm/521 nm.
Incubate plate in a humidified incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 18 h.
Add metabolic activity reagent (resazurin) at 1:10 (v/v) to each well.
Incubate plate in a humidified incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for an additional 6 h.
Measure fluorescence at 24 h post-encapsulation at 494 nm/521 nm for MMP activity.
Measure fluorescence at 24 h post-encapsulation at 560 nm/590 nm for metabolic activity.
